# Burton Normalization Notes

**Derived from:** `benchmarks/beckstead/source/burton-takeoff.pdf`  
**Output:** `burton-takeoff.normalized.json`  
**Generated by:** `artifacts/b2.2m.4/probe/runM4ProductCloseoutAudit.ts`

## Approach

Deterministic curation of framing-relevant quotation lines from PDF text extraction. Source PDF is **never modified**. Normalized JSON is reproducible derived output.

This initial normalization includes **representative framing lines** across all purchasing sections relevant to engine comparison. Full 116-line quotation can be expanded in future passes without changing source.

## Category mapping rules

| Burton pattern | normalizedFamily | inFramingEngineScope |
|----------------|------------------|----------------------|
| `*Stud*` | stud | yes |
| `*Plate*` | plate | yes |
| `2X10`, `2X8` header lumber | header | yes |
| `LVL`, `BEAM` | beam | yes |
| `6X6` | post | yes |
| `BCI`, `RIMBOARD`, `11PLUS` | floor_joist | yes |
| `T&G`, `834WBTG` | floor_sheathing | yes |
| `OSB`, `SHEATHING` | wall_roof_sheathing | yes |
| `TRUSS QUOTE`, `SOTR` | truss_package | yes (scope diff) |
| Doors, hardware, finish, foundation | various | **no** |

## Dimension extraction

- Stud/plate lines: parse `2X4`, `2X6` from description
- BCI: `11-7/8 BCI` from product code pattern
- Headers: lumber size from description (`2X10-10'`)

## Quantity layer tag

All Burton lines tagged **`procurement_convention`**. Engine output tagged **`calculated_requirement`**. Comparisons must prove scope equivalence before numeric delta.

## Assumptions (documented per line)

1. Burton row quantity is purchasing count, not plan-traceable calculated requirement
2. Section header defines purchasing scope boundary, not plan page
3. Tally strings (e.g. `244/8`) indicate stock-length grouping — not modeled in engine
4. Truss quote is lump-sum supplier package — not stick framing BOM

## Known gaps

- Not all 116 quotation lines normalized (doors, finish, full hardware omitted intentionally)
- Basement 2x4-96" lines may be stud or plate depending on estimator convention — mapped as plate family when description says plate, stud when says stud
- Garage 2x4-10' lines (66 ea) — likely plate pieces; scope reconciliation needed vs engine

## Scope equivalence gate

Before comparing engine 284 studs to any Burton stud line:

1. Map engine segments → pages 3–4 physical runs
2. Map Burton studs → purchasing section (1ST FLOOR WALLS only? + others?)
3. Confirm dimension layer (2x4 only vs 2x4+2x6 split)
4. If scope not proven → status `NOT_DIRECTLY_COMPARABLE`, no % delta
